content.title: Who Is Miley Cyrus’s Fiancé, Maxx Morando?
content.text: Miley Cyrus and boyfriend Maxx Morando have kept things pretty low-key across their four-year relationship—so low-key, in fact, that their sporadic public appearances tend to be followed by questions on social media like, “Who’s Miley’s hot date?” Well, it’s Maxx Morando, drummer for the Los Angeles rock band Lilly—and now, Cyrus’s fiancé.On December 1, when Cyrus and Morando attended the premiere of Avatar: Fire and Ash in Los Angeles, the 33-year-old pop star posed for photos on the red carpet with her hand placed upon the 27-year-old musician’s chest—and a diamond ring sparkling on her left ring finger. (It’s a cushion-cut stone on a 14k yellow gold band by Jacquie Aiche, the jeweler tapped by everyone from Rihanna to Gigi Hadid.) Sources confirmed the news to Page Six, and Morando’s father shared a congratulatory post on social media, showing the couple hugging and smiling with the caption: “❤️ 💍🍾🎉.”Below, find everything you need to know about Maxx Morando.Maxx Morando and Miley Cyrus at the Avatar: Fire and Ash premiere in Los Angeles on December 1. Photo: Getty ImagesHe and Cyrus met in 2021.Cyrus and Morando met on a blind date in 2021. (“Well, it was blind for me and not really for him,” Cyrus told British Vogue in 2023.) They’ve been living together in Malibu since at least 2024.Morando and Cyrus at the Guicci Love Parade show in Los Angeles in November 2021. Photo: Getty ImagesHe has an impressive music-industry résumé.Before joining Liily, Morando played drums for indie rock band the Regrettes from 2015 to 2018.He’s collaborated professionally with Cyrus before.Cyrus invited Morando and Liily to perform on her New Year’s Eve special on NBC in 2022, with a source saying at the time: “Miley insisted that Maxx’s band perform at her NYE special, and this was not something up for debate. Music is what bonds them together and they love nothing more than creating beautiful sounds when it is just the two of them.” Additionally, Morando and Cyrus worked together on the songs “Handstand” and “Violet Chemistry” from her 2023 album Endless Summer Vacation.The couple at the 2024 Grammy Awards. Photo: Getty ImagesMorando and Cyrus like to keep their high-profile appearances few and far between.Cyrus and Morando made their official red carpet debut at Gucci’s “Love Parade” show in November 2021. Years later, they stepped out for the 2024 and 2025 Grammys together (at the former, Cyrus thanked “my love” onstage after winning record of the year), as well as the 2025 Oscars, where Cyrus was a presenter.Miley Cyrus and Maxx Marando at the 2025 Grammys. Photo: Getty ImagesHe’s the designated phone carrier in the relationship.If you were Miley Cyrus, wouldn’t you ditch your phone occasionally? Apparently, that’s exactly what the star does, telling British Vogue of the couple’s phone protocol: “My boyfriend brings his phone and I don’t bring one.” If he’s willing to be plugged into the extremely online world for you, he might just be a keeper.
